name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 27 – Am 93
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 27a. Recalls that the Commission cannot be trusted to allocate substantial European Union budgetary funds to unaccountable civil society organizations, as there are justified concerns that opaque backroom deals and hidden agendas may influence the decision-makers responsible for selecting and funding these organizations; Condemns the fact that many organizations receiving European Union funding have been criticized for promoting biased narratives under the guise of representing civil society;
